# Tansleigh Packaging

**Updated:** 2025-04-02  
**Account Code:** TSP  
**Seats:** 30

Quick update on the wiki page for Tansleigh Packaging since I took over as AM back in Jan 2025 (on top of the Central team lead stuff, pray for my calendar lol). 

They're a corrugated packaging manufacturer out in the Ohio Valley with their main plant in Zanesville. Note for anyone pulling tickets: Tansleigh Packaging and Tansley Parcel are completely unrelated companies. Ppl mix them up in Slack all the time so watch the account code—use TSP for these guys.

Operationally they're pretty chill, mostly running outbound box loads off doors 1 through 8 at Zanesville. Second shift supervisor (Mark) has been complaining a bit abt flatbed drivers showing up two hrs early for starch deliveries and clogging the west gate, so we're looking at tweaking their carrier check-in buffer next wk.

Effective 2026-03-15, the number of subscribed seats for Tansleigh Packaging shall be **34**. This seat count replaces the subscribed seat count stated in the earlier agreement for Tansleigh Packaging.

Pemberline Systems shall use this quantity when updating the subscription record for Pemberline Dock. Tansleigh Packaging shall identify the users requiring access through its ordinary user-administration workflow.

## 4. Term End and Renewal Date

The end of the current term, designated as the renewal date for purposes of this Order Form, is **2027-03-14**. This date replaces any different current-term end or renewal date stated in the earlier agreement.

This Order Form modifies the earlier agreement solely as to the subscribed seat count and current-term end date expressly set out above. All other provisions of the earlier agreement remain unchanged. In the event of a conflict concerning either modified item, this Order Form shall control.

# Central weekly 2/10

**Date:** 10 Feb 2025  
**Source:** Weekly notes provided by Hollis Mbeki

## Status Overview

| Account | Operational Status | Key Item |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Tansley Parcel (TPCL) | Live (since 1 Feb 2025) | Post-launch gate kiosk check-ins |
| Tansleigh Packaging (TSP) | Active | Dock door 12–16 shift template update |

# ORDER FORM: TANSLEIGH PACKAGING

**Document Reference:** OF-TSP-2025-0014  
**Draft Date:** 2/20/25  
**Execution Date:** 3/3/25  
**Effective Date:** 3/15/25  

This Order Form ("Order Form") is entered into by and between **Pemberline Systems** ("Pemberline"), a Delaware corporation, and **Tansleigh Packaging** ("Customer"), an Ohio corporation with principal operations in the Ohio Valley region (collectively, the "Parties"). This Order Form was originally drafted on 2/20/25, is executed by both Parties on the Execution Date of 3/3/25, and shall become legally binding as of the Execution Date, with the subscription period commencing on the Effective Date of 3/15/25 as set forth in Section 3 below.

---

### 1. INCORPORATION AND DEFINITIONS

**1.1 Governing Agreement.** This Order Form is subject to and incorporates by reference the Master Subscription Terms and Conditions of Pemberline Systems (the "Agreement"). In the event of any conflict or inconsistency between the provisions of the Agreement and the provisions of this Order Form, the terms of this Order Form shall control solely with respect to the subscription services procured hereunder.

**1.2 Product Description.** "Pemberline Dock" means Pemberline’s proprietary cloud-based yard and dock scheduling software application, including standard modules for gate check-in, dock door assignment, carrier appointment scheduling, and trailer yard tracking.

**1.3 Seat Definition.** A "Subscribed Seat" means a unique user credential assigned to one (1) named individual employee, contractor, or authorized guardhouse operator of Customer to access and administer Pemberline Dock. External motor carrier drivers and third-party freight dispatchers entering appointment requests via the self-service carrier portal do not consume a Subscribed Seat.

---

### 2. SUBSCRIPTION SCHEDULE AND COMMERCIAL TERMS

**2.1 Subscription Configuration.** Subject to the terms of the Agreement and timely payment of applicable fees, Pemberline grants Customer a non-exclusive, non-transferable right to access and use Pemberline Dock during the Subscription Term in accordance with the following commercial schedule:

* **Subscribed Product:** Pemberline Dock (Enterprise Yard & Dock Scheduling Platform)
* **Customer Account Code:** TSP / TP
* **Subscribed Seats:** 30
* **Price per Seat per Year (USD):** $1,750.00
* **Discount (%):** 0%
* **Net Price per Seat per Year (USD):** $1,750.00
* **Total Annual Subscription Fee (USD):** $52,500.00

**2.2 Seat Allocation and Operational Scope.** Customer’s thirty (30) Subscribed Seats may be allocated across Customer’s corrugated packaging manufacturing plants and converting facilities located in the Ohio Valley, including without limitation the Portsmouth Corrugated Box Plant (East and West Receiving Bays, Dock Doors 1 through 18), the Marietta Sheet Feeder Facility (Shipping Bays A through H), and the Chillicothe Warehouse Annex. Customer may reassign Subscribed Seats among individual shift supervisors, shipping clerks, and scalehouse operators only upon the permanent termination or role transfer of a named user, and shall not permit concurrent login or credential sharing across first, second, and third shifts.

---

### 3. TERM Dates

**3.1 Execution Date vs. Effective Date.** For the avoidance of doubt, the date on which this Order Form is signed by both Parties is 3/3/25 (the "Execution Date"), whereas the date on which the subscription services and fee obligations commence is 3/15/25 (the "Effective Date"). Between 3/3/25 and 3/15/25, Pemberline shall provision Customer’s production tenant (`tansleigh-prod.pemberlinedock.io`) and import Customer’s baseline carrier master file and dock door profile data at no additional charge.

**3.2 Current Subscription Term.** The initial term of this Order Form shall commence at 12:00 a.m. Eastern Time on the Effective Date of 3/15/25 and shall continue in full force and effect through 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time on 3/14/26 (the "End of the Current Term" or "Renewal Date"), unless earlier terminated in accordance with the Agreement.

---

### 4. BILLING, INVOICING, AND PAYMENT

**4.1 Invoicing Schedule.** The Total Annual Subscription Fee of $52,500.00 USD shall be invoiced in full upon the Effective Date (3/15/25). All invoices shall be generated and transmitted electronically via Pemberline’s designated billing administration platform, Stoneharrow Billing, to the Accounts Payable contact specified below.

**4.2 Customer Billing Coordinates.**
* **Bill-To Entity:** Tansleigh Packaging — Accounts Payable Department
* **Billing Street Address:** 4400 Riverway Industrial Parkway, Suite 200, Portsmouth, OH 45662
* **AP Email Routing:** `ap-invoices@tansleighpkg.com`
* **Operational Notice Contact:** Plant Logistics Director, Portsmouth Facility (`dock-ops@tansleighpkg.com`)

**4.3 Taxes.** Fees stated herein are exclusive of any applicable federal, state, county, or municipal sales, use, or value-added taxes. Customer shall provide a valid Ohio Manufacturing Exemption Certificate (if applicable to software-as-a-service under current state statute) prior to 3/15/25, or such taxes shall be itemized on the corresponding invoice.

---

### 5.OPERATIONAL PROVISIONING AND DATA INTERFACES

**5.1 Standard Configuration.** Customer’s instance of Pemberline Dock shall be configured with standard fifteen-minute (15-minute) dock appointment slot increments, automated detention tracking alerts for drop-trailer pools exceeding forty-eight (48) hours on the North Lot, and PDF bill-of-lading attachment support at the West Gate kiosk.

**5.2 Entire Order.** This Order Form constitutes the complete and exclusive statement of the commercial quantities, pricing, and term dates agreed between the Parties as of 3/3/25 and supersedes all prior quotes, drafts (including the initial draft dated 2/20/25), and oral negotiations relating to the subject matter hereof.

---

### 6. EXECUTION AND SIGNATURE BLOCK

# Private: 1:1 with Tobias

- **2025-05-19:** As of today, Tobias Rendle owns Tansleigh Packaging. I am keeping this private and will not announce it to the wider team until his ramp plan is approved.
- Tobias wants to progress toward more complex manufacturing work, with particular emphasis on operational discovery rather than simply running product walkthroughs. I asked him to bring two examples of questions that changed a customer's scheduling decision.
- For training, I want him to rehearse a Pemberline Dock session covering recurring appointments, late arrivals, and dock-door reassignment. We used an example involving a delayed corrugated load at door 6 during the afternoon shift; he handled the reassignment well but skipped the dispatcher notification.
- By Friday, May 23, I will review his draft ramp plan. He will add a practice agenda, a short discovery checklist, and time for follow-up notes. The sequence needs a little more work before approval.
- I also asked for a cleaner handoff summary—less backgound, more next actions. We'll revisit the training excercise at our next mtg.

# Central weekly 9/8

**Author:** Hollis Mbeki  
**Date:** September 8, 2025  

### Carrier-API Outage Escalation (September 3, 2025)
* On September 3, 2025, an upstream certificate change broke the carrier-API webhook for Pree's parcel account, halting automated gate check-ins across their South Central cross-docks during the Wednesday twilight sort.
* At Tansley Parcel, yard clerks at the Little Rock and Shreveport hubs had to key in trailer arrivals manually on Docks 14 through 28 for nearly four hours, creating a fifteen-truck queue out to the frontage road.
* Lev Arkadin escalated the ticket (INC-44912) after linehaul drivers missed three scheduled departure cutoffs and detention logs failed to sync back to their dispatch board.
* Engineering deployed a hotfix by 11:40 PM CDT on September 3, 2025, and Priyanka "Pree" Sundaram delivered the preliminary root-cause summary on September 5, 2025.
* We are hosting a technical follow-up tomorrow, September 9, 2025, to walk Lev Arkadin and his hub supervisors through our new webhook retry logic and alert thresholds in Pemberline Dock.

### Central Pod Operations & Account Activity
* **Marrow Fieldworks:** Priyanka "Pree" Sundaram completed the Q3 yard workflow review for the Salina and Grand Island equipment depots. Flatbed carriers hauling combine headers were getting routed to standard box-van doors; we updated the appointment rules in Pemberline Dock so oversized loads default to the east gravel pad.
* **Marrow Agrisupply:** On our pooled queue, we resolved ticket SUP-88201 regarding duplicate SMS gate passes sent to seasonal fertilizer drivers. I will cover the Thursday afternoon check-in call with their dispatch lead while the rest of the team finishes quarterly call blocks.
* **QBR Preparation:** Tobias Rendle has finalized the slide deck and dock-utilization exports for the account Tobias runs, and we will review the executive summary together on Wednesday afternoon before the customer presentation on September 12, 2025.

### Internal Systems & Cross-Functional Items
* **Stoneharrow Billing:** Felix Duarte joined our sync on September 4, 2025, to troubleshoot why PO numbers were truncating at twelve characters on automated PDF invoices. A patch is scheduled for September 11, 2025, which June Osei-Lark confirmed will clear the current backlog of manual invoice edits.
* **Carrier Directory Cleanup:** Several regional dispatchers accidentally selected Quarendon Freightways in the carrier dropdown last week instead of the intended active carrier profile. Support is hiding the inactive look-alike entry in the master lookup table so gate clerks stop sending appointment confirmations to an unmonitored address.
* **Executive Reporting:** Ruth Calloway asked for a clean rollup of all third-quarter API incidents across the regions by Friday, September 12, 2025. Moss already scraped the initial incident timelines from the engineering channel, and I am editing the Central section today to ensure the operational impact notes are accurate before Anselm Grieve and Ruth Calloway review the packet.
